plan: Given my private value of $26, I aim to bid just above the expected average value of $10 to $15 to maximize profit while minimizing costs. Since there is no history, I assume others bid close to their value. I'll bid $15.1 to outbid average bids, ensuring a win and profit if competitors bid around the mean.

Given my private value of $28, I aim to maximize profit by winning the item at the lowest cost. The optimal bid should be slightly above the expected bids of Andy and Charles. Assuming their values are uniformly distributed between $0 and $20, a competitive bid would be slightly above $20. I will bid $20.1 to outbid typical maximum values while ensuring potential profit, as I will only pay the second-highest bid.

Given my value of $21, I should aim to bid slightly above the average expected value of the other bidders to maximize profit. Since values are drawn uniformly between $0 and $20, the average value is $10. I will bid slightly above this to ensure a win, but not so much that it significantly reduces my profit. A bid of $15 balances winning likelihood and profit.
